name: Formico – Elementor Form Builder Addons, Fields & CRM Integrations
author: PluginsCafe

sections.description:
Take your Elementor Pro form building capabilities to the next level with Formico! The easiest and most lightweight Elementor Pro form extensions bundle. Supercharge your lead generation and user experience with powerful new form fields, clever extensions, and seamless CRM integrations.

Whether you need to collect signatures, create visual options with an image picker, ensure data formatting with input masks, or connect directly to platforms like Brevo and Klaviyo, Formico has you covered.

Key Features Include:

  • Powerful Form Extensions: Input Mask, Google Places Address Autocomplete.
  • Advanced Custom Fields: Signature Field, Image Picker Field, Smart Phone Field, Range Slider Field, Multiple Choice Field.
  • Seamless Integrations: Send leads directly to Brevo (Sendinblue) and Klaviyo.

After installation, simply navigate to the Formico menu in your admin dashboard to activate the specific extensions and fields you want to use in your Elementor forms.

Form Field Extensions

  • Input Mask: Easily format user input for phone numbers, dates, zip codes, and more to ensure clean, accurate data collection without validation errors.
  • Address Auto Complete via Google Places API: Accelerate checkout and form submissions by predicting and auto-filling accurate addresses using Google Maps integration.

Form Fields

  • Smart Phone Field: Automatically validate and format international phone numbers with built-in country code selection and flag dropdowns for global reach.
  • Range Slider Field: Allow users to select a value or range of values seamlessly with a highly customizable, mobile-friendly slider interface.
  • Signature Field: Effortlessly capture electronic signatures directly within your Elementor forms, perfect for contracts, applications, and legal agreements.
  • Image Picker Field: Boost user engagement by letting them select options visually through clickable images instead of traditional radio buttons or checkboxes.
  • Multiple Choice Field: Give users an intuitive and styled way to select one or multiple options to quickly gather their preferences or answers.

Integrations

  • Brevo (formerly SendInBlue): Automatically sync new form submissions to your Brevo account to trigger email marketing campaigns and manage your subscribers seamlessly.
  • Klaviyo: Connect your forms directly to Klaviyo to build powerful, targeted customer segments and automate your SMS and email marketing flows.
  • User Registration: Easily allow users to create a WordPress account directly from your Elementor forms, streamlining the onboarding process.

Google Map API for address auto complete.

To use the address auto-complete extension, a Google Maps API key is required. If an API key is not added in the Formico settings, the address auto-complete options will be hidden. Here are some useful links about obtaining a Google Maps API key:

Youtube Video

Get Google API Key

Requirements

  • PHP 7.4
  • Elementor Pro
sections.installation:
1. Install Formico plugin
  2. Make sure you also have Elementor Pro activated.
